ContentSearch_PluginDesc: Fast local file content full-text search plugin powered by SQLite FTS5
ContentSearch_ProviderDesc: Search document content using a trigger keyword
ContentSearch_Config_TriggerDesc: Keyword followed by a space in the search bar to trigger content search (default: cs)
ContentSearch_Config_FoldersDesc: List of local folders to index, supports environment variables (e.g. %USERPROFILE%)
ContentSearch_Config_MaxSizeDesc: Files exceeding this size will be skipped to prevent excessive memory and CPU consumption
ContentSearch_Config_ExtensionsDesc: Comma-separated list of file extensions (e.g. txt,md,docx,pdf)
ContentSearch_Config_ExclusionsDesc: Semicolon-separated regular expressions; any file or folder whose full path matches is excluded from indexing (e.g. .*\backup\; .*\.tmp$)
ContentSearch_PlaceholderDesc: Indexed {0} files · Enter keywords to search file content
ContentSearch_NoResultsDesc: No content containing "{0}" was found in indexed files
ContentSearch_IndexingWithRemainingDesc: Indexing files in background (indexed {0} files, {1} remaining)...
